summary: Gary Smith, 37, of Vail, was caught in a small soft-slab avalanche in Sanctuary Chute in the Lime Creek drainage south of Beaver Creek/Edwards; he was carried roughly 1,000 vertical feet through a rock-walled chute and over a 75-foot cliff, buried under about two feet of debris and killed. His partner triggered a second small slide while searching but skied out, then located and uncovered Smith with transceiver, probe and shovel and called 911.
location: Sanctuary Chute, Lime Creek, south of Beaver Creek (Edwards)
notes: CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row: 'Lime Creek south of Edwards | 2 sidecountry skiers caught, 1 buried and killed'. CAIC full accident report (quoted in SnowBrains): Skier 1 triggered a small soft slab in a steep NW-facing below-treeline chute, carried over a 75-foot cliff and buried under ~2 feet of debris; partner's companion rescue found him deceased; Eagle County Sheriff's Department, Beaver Creek Ski Patrol and Vail Mountain Rescue Group responded.
